privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy matters to us. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacy.section_0_body: We collect information you provide directly to us such as name, phone number, email address, and delivery addresses. We also collect usage data including pages visited, products viewed, and purchase history to improve your experience.
privacy.section_1_body: We use your information to process orders, deliver products, send order updates, provide customer support, personalize your shopping experience, and send promotional offers (with your consent). We never sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.section_2_body: We may share your information with trusted delivery partners and payment processors solely to fulfil your orders. All third parties are contractually obligated to protect your data and use it only for the specific purpose of fulfilling services on our behalf.
privacy.section_3_body: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, remember your preferences, and analyze platform usage. You can control cookie settings through your browser. Disabling cookies may affect certain platform features.
privacy.section_4_body: We implement industry-standard security measures including SSL encryption, secure servers, and regular security audits to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.section_5_body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You can update your account information through the profile section, or contact our support team to request data deletion. We will process your request within 30 days.
privacy.section_6_body: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact our Data Protection team at privacy@fastway.app. We are committed to resolving any concerns promptly and transparently.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using our platform.
terms.section_0_body: By accessing or using the Subhaty platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you are prohibited from using or accessing this platform.
terms.section_1_body: To access certain features of the platform, you may be required to register for an account. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
terms.section_2_body: All prices displayed on the platform are in Saudi Riyals (SAR) and are inclusive of VAT where applicable. We reserve the right to modify prices at any time. Payment must be completed at the time of order. We accept major credit cards, debit cards, Apple Pay, Tamara, and Tabby.
terms.section_3_body: Subhaty offers standard and express delivery options. Delivery times are estimates and may vary based on your location, product availability, and other factors. We are not liable for delays caused by events beyond our control.
terms.section_4_body: We offer a 7-day return policy for most products in their original condition and packaging. Certain products including opened supplements and perishable items may not be eligible for return. Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days after the return is received and inspected.
terms.section_5_body: All content on this platform including text, graphics, logos, and software is the property of Subhaty and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our express written permission.
terms.section_6_body: Subhaty shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform. Our total liability in any matter arising from your use of the platform shall not exceed the amount you paid for the relevant order.
terms.section_7_body: We reserve the right to modify these Terms & Conditions at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting to the platform. Your continued use of the platform after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the modified terms.

shipping.title: Shipping Rules
shipping.subtitle: Fast, reliable delivery across Saudi Arabia.
shipping.section_0_body: Subhaty delivers across all major cities in Saudi Arabia including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Mecca, Medina, and more. We are continuously expanding our coverage to reach every corner of the Kingdom.
shipping.section_1_body: Standard delivery is available for all orders and typically takes 2–5 business days. Delivery fees are calculated based on your location and order weight. Orders above SAR 200 qualify for free standard shipping.
shipping.section_2_body: Express delivery delivers your order within 2 hours from the nearest fulfillment center. Express is available for eligible products in covered areas. The express eligibility badge is shown on eligible product pages. Express delivery incurs an additional fee.
shipping.section_3_body: Orders placed before 2:00 PM (Sunday through Thursday) are processed the same day. Orders placed after 2:00 PM or on weekends and public holidays are processed the next business day. You will receive an SMS and app notification once your order is dispatched.
shipping.section_4_body: Our delivery team will attempt delivery twice. If both attempts fail due to customer unavailability, the order will be held at our nearest facility for 3 days. After this period, the order may be returned and a re-delivery fee will apply.
shipping.section_5_body: Some products require refrigerated shipping to maintain quality and effectiveness. These items are shipped in insulated packaging with cold packs. Cold chain products must be stored in the refrigerator immediately upon receipt. Additional shipping fees apply.
shipping.section_6_body: You can track your order in real time from the My Orders section in the app. You will receive SMS updates at each stage: order confirmed, dispatched, and out for delivery. For any tracking concerns, contact our support team.

returns.title: Return Policy
returns.subtitle: Shop with confidence — easy returns within 7 days.
returns.section_0_body: Products may be returned within 7 days of delivery, provided they are in their original, unused condition with all original packaging, tags, and accessories intact. The product must not be damaged, altered, or show signs of use.
returns.section_1_body: The following items cannot be returned: opened or partially consumed supplements, vitamins, and rosary powders; perishable or refrigerated products; personal hygiene products; products marked as final sale; and items damaged due to misuse.
returns.section_2_body: To start a return: (1) Log into your account and go to My Orders. (2) Select the order containing the item you wish to return. (3) Tap 'Return Item' and select the reason. (4) Our team will review your request and contact you within 1–2 business days to arrange collection.
returns.section_3_body: Once your returned item is received and inspected, your refund will be processed within 5–10 business days. Refunds are credited to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, refunds are issued as store credit or bank transfer.
returns.section_4_body: If you received a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the issue. We will arrange an immediate replacement or full refund at no cost to you, including return shipping.
returns.section_5_body: For standard returns, the customer is responsible for return shipping costs. If the return is due to our error (wrong item, defective product), we will cover the full return shipping cost and arrange a pickup from your address.
